symptom: Customers report that checkout orders are not completing as expected

report.summary: Checkout failures trace to payment-service calls from order-service timing out. Order-service logs 6 PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE HttpTimeoutException warnings and 6 orders stuck PAYMENT_PENDING, with 0 payment-side errors. Payment-service sees 12 payment attempts and gateway-mock answers 200 quickly (p99-ish max ~1.2s, mean 1ms), while payment-service /payments max latency is 10s, showing slowness inside payment-service's gateway wait. Root cause points to payment-service response latency, but evidence…
